drive._comment: Point these at your Google Drive for Desktop folders. On a Mac usually /Users/<you>/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-<account>/Shared drives/...; on Windows usually G:\Shared drives\...  Relative paths resolve from the repository root.

model._comment: preset picks the endpoint; TOWN_PRESET / TOWN_MODEL / TOWN_API_KEY in the environment always win. Presets: claude, deepseek, qwen, moonshot, groq, together, openrouter, ollama, local. Leave preset null to run the rule layer only, free.

review._comment: only/skip accept agent ids (astra) or guild ids (lumen). Empty means everyone whose check applies to the document type.
